$comment: The app's visual-parity contract, read by design-visual-parity's scripts. The design frames themselves are the screen-contract states with a "reference" (contracts/screens.json, screen-contracts); this file adds the done set (themes x languages x devices), where the references, waivers, sign-off ledger, runs and summary live, the mockup adapter, the layout facts the gates need, the measured type-role floors, the app's facts, the harness folder and per-frame settings.
